title: The role of conservation in United States' agricultural policy from the Dust Bowl to today: a critical assessment
Death by a thousand cuts": Conservation stakeholders' perspectives on protecting freshwater lakes in a tourist region surrounded by agriculture
abstract: Freshwater systems are complex social-ecological systems (SES) impacted by multiple activities within watershed boundaries beyond their shorelines. Since many of these systems provide important ecosystem services, are threatened, and are managed by complex governance structures, there is a need for empirical work to understand how social setting and interactions between stakeholders impact governance. This study assesses conservation stakeholders’ perspectives in the Iowa Great Lakes region, a valuable freshwater system that is a popular tourist destination nested within an intense agricultural production region. Conservationists work within a polycentric governance structure to protect the Lakes. Using 23 semi-structured interviews and the SES Framework, we examine the environmental pressures facing the region, barriers to mitigation efforts, and solutions within a polycentric system. Our results highlight the difficulties in using voluntary conservation measures to mitigate environmental pressures and the challenges of involving non-conservation stakeholders given competing goals and limited resources.
abstract_zh: 淡水系统是复杂的社会生态系统（SES），受到其岸线以外流域边界内多种活动的影响。由于这些系统中的许多提供重要的生态系统服务、受到威胁，并由复杂的治理结构进行管理，因此需要进行实证研究，以理解社会环境和利益相关者之间的互动如何影响治理。本研究评估了爱荷华大湖区保护利益相关者的观点。该地区是一个宝贵的淡水系统，也是热门旅游目的地，同时嵌于高强度农业生产区域之中。保护人士在多中心治理结构内工作以保护这些湖泊。通过23次半结构化访谈并运用SES框架，我们考察了该地区面临的环境压力、缓解努力的障碍，以及多中心体系中的解决方案。我们的结果凸显了利用自愿保护措施缓解环境压力的困难，以及在目标相互竞争且资源有限的情况下，让非保护类利益相关者参与其中的挑战。

title: What decades of policies aimed at agricultural water pollution can teach us about agricultural climate change mitigation: a US perspective
abstract: The Inflation Reduction Act has catalyzed resources for climate change mitigation in several sectors of the US economy, including agriculture. As these activities ramp up, a clear delineation of the US approach to agricultural climate mitigation is emerging. Practices and policy frameworks are similar to those used to address water quality concerns from agriculture, which started in the 1970s. In fact, some of the programs being deployed to address climate change are the same. In both cases, policies rely on a voluntary approach and subsidies, and focus on practices not outcomes. The experience of agricultural water quality programs can provide useful insights on the effectiveness of the approach being used in agricultural climate change mitigation. Voluntary practices have generally been ineffective in improving water quality. More comprehensive policies, or at least better targeted ones, and more system-based analytical capacity are needed.
abstract_zh: 《通货膨胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act）为美国经济多个部门（包括农业）的气候变化减缓提供了资金支持。随着这些举措逐步加速，美国农业气候减缓的路径正逐渐清晰。其实践与政策框架与应对农业水质问题所采用的框架相似，而后者可以追溯到20世纪70年代。事实上，部分用于应对气候变化的项目与水质项目完全相同。两类政策都依赖自愿参与和补贴，并且关注的是做法而非结果。农业水质计划的经验可以为评估当前农业气候变化减缓所采用路径的有效性提供有益的启示。自愿性做法总体上未能有效改善水质。需要更加全面的政策，或至少是更具针对性的政策，同时还需要更强的系统性分析能力。

title: Complying with conservation compliance? An assessment of recent evidence in the US Corn Belt
abstract: Conservation provisions of US farm bills since 1985 have been aimed at mitigating negative environmental impacts of US agriculture. One of the long term goals has been to protect against soil erosion, with a focus specifically on highly erodible land (HEL). Conservation Compliance (CC) mandates that, in order to receive federal subsidies, farmers who plant annual crops on HEL must implement a conservation plan, with practices such as rotating crops and no-till farming. When crop prices increase, however, the incentives not to follow the plan increase, as conservation activities can reduce farmers’ profits. This study is the first to assess the performance of conservation compliance between 2007 and 2019, a period of historically high and variable crop prices, using geographical information system tools and crop data in a critical agricultural production region, the US Corn Belt. Our results indicate there was a substantial increase in continuous corn on HEL, a proxy measure for non-compliance, in several portions of the study area in correspondence with higher crop prices following the 2007 Energy Bill. This mirrored the change in crop rotations on all cropland. The increase was positively correlated with both absolute and relative corn prices. While at the height of absolute and relative corn prices there were increases in continuous corn on HEL everywhere across the study region except parts of Missouri, some of the largest changes occurred in environmentally sensitive regions and areas which use irrigation, thereby potentially creating disproportionate environmental impacts. Similar changes in continuous corn also occurred in all cropland in the region, indicating that mandatory conservation programs are as vulnerable to periods of high crop prices as voluntary programs. Better monitoring for both CC and other conservation programs is critical to ensure the policies work as intended.
abstract_zh: 自1985年以来，美国农业法案中的保护条款旨在减轻美国农业对环境的负面影响。其长期目标之一是防止土壤侵蚀，并特别关注高度易蚀土地（highly erodible land, HEL）。保护合规（Conservation Compliance, CC）规定，农民若要获得联邦补贴，并在高度易蚀土地上种植一年生作物，就必须实施保护计划，例如轮作和免耕等做法。然而，当作物价格上涨时，不遵守该计划的动机随之增强，因为保护性措施可能会减少农民的利润。本研究首次利用地理信息系统工具和作物数据，评估了2007年至2019年期间保护合规的实施绩效。这一时期作物价格历史性地高企且波动剧烈，研究区域为关键的农业生产地区——美国玉米带（US Corn Belt）。研究结果表明，在2007年《能源法案》之后作物价格上涨的背景下，研究区域多个地段的高度易蚀土地上连作玉米的面积大幅增加；连作玉米可作为不合规的代理指标。这一变化与全部耕地上轮作模式的变化相一致。该增长与玉米的绝对价格和相对价格均呈正相关。在玉米绝对价格和相对价格处于峰值时，除密苏里州部分地区外，研究区域内各处高度易蚀土地上的连作玉米均有所增加；其中一些最大的变化发生在环境敏感地区以及使用灌溉的地区，因而可能造成不成比例的环境影响。整个区域的全部耕地上连作玉米也出现了类似变化，这表明强制性保护计划与自愿性计划一样，容易受到高作物价格时期的冲击。加强对保护合规及其他保护计划的监测，对确保政策按预期发挥作用至关重要。

title: Geographic-scale harvest program to promote invasivorism of bigheaded carps
A Dynamic Semester-Long Social Dilemma Game for Economic and Inter-Disciplinary Courses
A Regional Comparison of Factors Affecting Global Sorghum Production: The Case of North America, Asia and Africa's Sahel
Constraints on Farmer Adaptability in the Iowa-Cedar River Basin
The state of water quality strategies in the Mississippi River Basin: Is cooperative federalism working?
abstract: There is consensus that the Clean Water Act (CWA) has generally been effective in addressing point source pollution in the US. There is also consensus that non-point source (NPS) pollution, particularly from agriculture, remains a problem. The potential for the CWA framework to affect change is unclear, due to the limited power of the US federal government in addressing NPS, the contentiousness surrounding it, and the lack of funding to implement plans that have been developed. States are critical in improving water quality in the U.S. In the Mississippi River Basin, State-level Nutrient Reduction Strategies are the vehicle chosen by the Environmental Protection Agency to improve water quality. We develop an assessment of the twelve Mississippi River states' strategies. We consider three issues: whether there is science-based support for a choice, with a focus on NPS; if and how updates on progress are available; and whether there is alignment of funding and abatement priorities. We find that the use of best science is limited, the role of livestock in pollution and its abatement is ignored, and the development of Numeric Nutrient Criteria is stalled. Further, several states have not reported on their progress, and there has been little additional funding for pollution reduction. This analysis can inform broader discussions on decentralized approaches to address water quality.
abstract_zh: 学界普遍认为，《清洁水法》（Clean Water Act, CWA）总体上在解决美国点源污染问题方面是有效的。学界同样普遍认为，非点源（non-point source, NPS）污染，尤其是来自农业的污染，仍然是一个问题。由于美国联邦政府在应对非点源污染方面权限有限，该问题存在较大争议，且已制定的规划缺乏实施资金，因此《清洁水法》框架能否带来改变尚不明确。各州对于改善美国水质至关重要。在密西西比河流域，美国环境保护署（EPA）选定各州的营养物减排战略（State-level Nutrient Reduction Strategies）作为改善水质的工具。我们对密西西比河沿岸12个州的战略进行了评估。我们考察了三个问题：各州的选择是否有科学依据（重点关注非点源污染）；各州的进展信息是否公开，以及如何获取；资金安排与减排优先事项是否一致。我们发现，最佳科学证据的运用十分有限，畜牧业在污染及其减排中的作用被忽视，而数值营养物标准（Numeric Nutrient Criteria）的制定也陷入停滞。此外，若干州未报告其进展，而用于减少污染的额外资金也很少。这一分析可以为有关分散化方法改善水质的更广泛讨论提供参考。

title: Valuation of Ecosystem Services in Alternative Bioenergy Landscape Scenarios
abstract: Agricultural land in the Midwest is a source of food and fuel, as well as biodiversity. It is also a cause of excess nutrients that make their way to the Mississippi River and the Gulf of Mexico. To address unsustainable changes to biogeochemical cycles and ecosystem functions, a multidisciplinary approach involving social science, natural science, and engineering is often effective. Given the potential of second‐generation biofuels, and capitalizing on the deep‐rooted perennial bioenergy crops capable of thriving in poor soils, we demonstrated an integrated socio‐environmental analysis of the impacts of growing switchgrass within row‐crop landscapes in Illinois. In this study, we model land use scenarios that incorporate switchgrass as a biofuel crop in a Midwest corn‐belt watershed using the Soil Water Assessment Tool coupled with an economic analysis for the Vermilion Basin in Illinois. We estimated the values of ecosystem services under an alternative bioenergy landscape, including commodity and bioenergy crops, changes in biogeochemistry, and recreational services. The estimated annual values of nitrate and sediment reduction attributed to bioenergy crops range from $38 million to $97 million and $16,000 to $197,000, respectively. The annual value of carbon dioxide emission reduction ranges from $1.8 million to $6.1 million based on the initial crop rotation pattern. Estimated average annual values for wildlife viewing, water‐based recreation, and pheasant hunting are $1.24 million, $0.17 million, and $0.3 million, respectively. To our knowledge, this study represents the first effort to comprehensively quantify ecosystem services using a process‐based model, and estimate their value in an alternative bioenergy landscape. The information we generate could aid in understanding the potential for biomass production from marginal land and the total economic value of the landscape at various spatial scales. The framework is useful in fostering alternative bioenergy landscapes with synergies in a food, energy, and conservation nexus.
abstract_zh: 美国中西部的农业用地既是食物和燃料的来源，也是生物多样性的载体。同时，这些土地也是过量营养物的来源，这些营养物会流入密西西比河并最终进入墨西哥湾。为应对生物地球化学循环和生态系统功能的不可持续变化，通常需要社会科学、自然科学和工程学相结合的多学科方法。鉴于第二代生物燃料的潜力，以及深根多年生生物能源作物在贫瘠土壤中生长的优势，我们展示了一项综合性社会—环境分析，考察了在伊利诺伊州的行列作物景观中种植柳枝稷（switchgrass）的影响。在本研究中，我们利用土壤与水评估工具（Soil Water Assessment Tool, SWAT）结合伊利诺伊州维米利翁流域（Vermilion Basin）的经济分析，模拟了将柳枝稷作为生物燃料作物纳入中西部玉米带流域的土地利用情景。我们估算了替代性生物能源景观下生态系统服务的价值，包括商品作物和生物能源作物、生物地球化学变化以及休闲服务。归因于生物能源作物的硝酸盐和泥沙减少所带来的年度价值估计分别为3800万至9700万美元，以及1.6万至19.7万美元。根据初始轮作模式，二氧化碳减排的年度价值为180万至610万美元。观鸟、水上休闲和雉鸡狩猎的平均年度价值估计分别为124万美元、17万美元和30万美元。据我们所知，本研究首次利用基于过程的模型全面量化生态系统服务，并估算其在替代性生物能源景观中的价值。我们所生成的信息有助于理解边际土地的生物质生产潜力，以及在不同空间尺度上景观的总经济价值。该框架有助于在食物、能源和保护的关联关系中促进具有协同效应的替代性生物能源景观。

title: An Analysis of the Climate Change Mitigation Potential through Soil Organic Carbon Sequestration in a Corn Belt Watershed
Projecting corn and soybeans yields under climate change in a Corn Belt watershed
Simulation of targeted pollutant-mitigation-strategies to reduce nitrate and sediment hotspots in agricultural watershed
Adaptation in the Tisza: innovation and tribulation at the sub-basin level
An Examination of Growing Trends in Land Tenure and Conservation Practice Adoption: Results from a Farmer Survey in Iowa
abstract: Tenants and part-owners are farming an increasing number of acres in the United States, while full-owners are farming fewer acres. This shift in ownership is a potential cause for concern because some previous research indicated that tenant and part-owner farmers were less likely to adopt conservation practices than farmers who owned the land they farmed. If that trend persists, ownership changes would signal a national drop in conservation adoption. Here we examine this issue using a survey of agricultural operators in the Clear Creek watershed in Iowa, a state with intensive agricultural production. We compare adoption of conservation practices, and preferences for conservation information sources and communication channels, between farmers who rent some portion of the land they farm (tenants and part-owners) and farmers who own all of the land they farm (full-owners). We find that renters are more likely to practice conservation tillage than full-owners, though they are less likely to rotate crops. In addition, renters report using federal government employees (specifically, Natural Resource Conservation Service and Farm Service Agency) as their primary sources of conservation information, while full-owners most frequently rely on neighbors, friends, and County Extension. These findings are significant for conservation policy because, unlike some past research, they indicate that renters are not resistant to all types of conservation practices, echoing recent studies finding an increase in conservation adoption among non-full-owners. Our results emphasize the importance of government conservation communication and can inform outreach efforts by helping tailor effective, targeted conservation strategies for owners and renters.
abstract_zh: 在美国，租地经营者和部分自有土地的经营者所耕种的土地面积日益增加，而全部自有土地的经营者所耕种的面积却在减少。这种土地所有权结构的转变可能引发担忧，因为已有研究表明，租地经营者和部分自有土地经营者采用保护性做法的可能性低于自有土地经营者。如果这一趋势持续下去，土地所有权的变化将意味着全国保护性做法采用率的下降。在此，我们利用对艾奥瓦州克利尔溪流域（Clear Creek watershed）农业经营者的调查来考察这一问题。该州农业生产集约化程度很高。我们比较了租用部分耕地的经营者（租地经营者和部分自有土地经营者）与全部耕地为自有的经营者（全部自有土地经营者）之间，在保护性做法的采用情况、对保护信息来源和沟通渠道的偏好方面的差异。我们发现，与全部自有土地经营者相比，租地经营者更可能采用保护性耕作（conservation tillage），尽管他们实行轮作的可能性较低。此外，租地经营者表示，他们主要依靠联邦政府工作人员（具体为自然资源保护局（NRCS）和农场服务局（FSA））获取保护信息，而全部自有土地经营者最常依赖邻居、朋友以及县级推广机构（County Extension）。这些发现对保护政策具有重要意义，因为与以往部分研究不同，它们表明租地经营者并非对所有类型的保护性做法都持抵触态度，这也与近期研究发现非全部自有土地经营者的保护采用率有所提高相呼应。我们的结果强调了政府保护信息传播的重要性，并可通过帮助针对所有者和租地者量身定制有效、有针对性的保护策略，为推广工作提供参考。

title: Applying geospatial tools to assess the agricultural value of Lower Illinois River floodplain levee districts
Assessment of impacts of agricultural and climate change scenarios on watershed water quantity and quality, and crop production
abstract: Modeling impacts of agricultural scenarios and climate change on surface water quantity and quality provides useful information for planning effective water, environmental, and land use policies. Despite the significant impacts of agriculture on water quantity and quality, limited literature exists that describes the combined impacts of agricultural land use change and climate change on future bioenergy crop yields and watershed hydrology. In this study, the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) eco-hydrological model was used to model the combined impacts of five agricultural land use change scenarios and three downscaled climate pathways (representative concentration pathways, RCPs) that were created from an ensemble of eight atmosphere-ocean general circulation models (AOGCMs). These scenarios were implemented in a well calibrated SWAT model for the Raccoon River watershed (RRW) located in western Iowa. The scenarios were executed for the historical baseline, early-century, mid-century, and late-century periods. The results indicate that historical and more corn intensive agricultural scenarios with higher CO2 emissions consistently result in more water in the streams and greater water quality problems, especially late in the 21st century. Planting more switchgrass, on the other hand, results in less water in the streams and water quality improvements relative to the baseline. For all given agricultural landscapes simulated, all flow, sediment and nutrient outputs increase from early-to-late century periods for the RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 climate scenarios. We also find that corn and switchgrass yields are negatively impacted under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 scenarios in the mid and late 21st century.
abstract_zh: 对农业情景和气候变化影响地表水水量与水质进行建模，可为规划有效的水资源、环境和土地利用政策提供有用信息。尽管农业对水量和水质影响显著，但关于农业土地利用变化与气候变化对未来生物能源作物产量和流域水文的综合影响，现有文献仍然有限。在本研究中，我们利用水土评估工具（Soil and Water Assessment Tool, SWAT）生态水文模型，模拟了五种农业土地利用变化情景与三种降尺度气候路径（代表性浓度路径，RCPs）的综合影响，其中气候路径由八个大气—海洋环流模式（AOGCMs）的集合生成。这些情景在位于爱荷华州西部的浣熊河流域（Raccoon River watershed, RRW）经过良好校准的SWAT模型中得以实施。情景分别在历史基准期、本世纪初期、中期和末期运行。结果表明，历史情景以及玉米种植更为集中、二氧化碳排放量更高的农业情景，始终导致河流水量增加，并带来更严重的水质问题，尤其是在21世纪后期。相比之下，增加柳枝稷种植面积则会使河流水量减少，并使水质相对基准情景有所改善。在所模拟的所有农业景观中，在RCP4.5和RCP8.5气候情景下，从本世纪初期到末期，所有径流、泥沙和营养物输出均会增加。我们还发现，在RCP4.5和RCP8.5情景下，21世纪中后期玉米和柳枝稷的产量均受到负面影响。

title: Continuous Corn and Corn-Soybean Profits over a 45-Year Tillage and Fertilizer Experiment
Modeling Agricultural Watersheds with the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT): Calibration and Validation with a Novel Procedure for Spatially Explicit HRUs
abstract: Applications of the Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT) model typically involve delineation of a watershed into subwatersheds/subbasins that are then further subdivided into hydrologic response units (HRUs) which are homogeneous areas of aggregated soil, landuse, and slope and are the smallest modeling units used within the model. In a given standard SWAT application, multiple potential HRUs (farm fields) in a subbasin are usually aggregated into a single HRU feature. In other words, the standard version of the model combines multiple potential HRUs (farm fields) with the same landuse/landcover, soil, and slope, but located at different places of a subbasin (spatially non-unique), and considers them as one HRU. In this study, ArcGIS pre-processing procedures were developed to spatially define a one-to-one match between farm fields and HRUs (spatially unique HRUs) within a subbasin prior to SWAT simulations to facilitate input processing, input/output mapping, and further analysis at the individual farm field level. Model input data such as landuse/landcover (LULC), soil, crop rotation, and other management data were processed through these HRUs. The SWAT model was then calibrated/validated for Raccoon River watershed in Iowa for 2002-2010 and Big Creek River watershed in Illinois for 2000-2003. SWAT was able to replicate annual, monthly, and daily streamflow, as well as sediment, nitrate and mineral phosphorous within recommended accuracy in most cases. The one-to-one match between farm fields and HRUs created and used in this study is a first step in performing LULC change, climate change impact, and other analyses in a more spatially explicit manner.
abstract_zh: 土壤与水评估工具（SWAT）模型的应用通常包括将流域划分为若干子流域，再进一步细分为水文响应单元（Hydrologic Response Units, HRUs）。水文响应单元是由土壤、土地利用和坡度聚合而成的同质区域，是模型中使用的最小建模单元。在标准的SWAT应用中，子流域内多个潜在的水文响应单元（即农田）通常被合并为单一的水文响应单元。换言之，标准版模型会将土地利用/土地覆被、土壤和坡度相同、但位于子流域不同位置（空间上不唯一）的多个潜在水文响应单元（农田）合并，并视为同一个水文响应单元。在本研究中，我们开发了基于ArcGIS的预处理程序，在进行SWAT模拟之前，在子流域内建立农田与水文响应单元之间一一对应的空间关系（空间唯一的水文响应单元），以便于输入数据处理、输入输出映射以及在单块农田层面的进一步分析。土地利用/土地覆被（LULC）、土壤、轮作以及其他管理数据等模型输入数据均通过这些水文响应单元进行处理。随后，我们对爱荷华州浣熊河流域（2002–2010年）和伊利诺伊州大溪流域（Big Creek River watershed，2000–2003年）的SWAT模型进行了校准与验证。在大多数情况下，SWAT能够在推荐的精度范围内重现年度、月度和日度径流，以及泥沙、硝酸盐和矿物磷的变化。本研究所建立的农田与水文响应单元之间的一一对应关系，是以更具空间明确性的方式开展土地利用/土地覆被变化、气候变化影响及其他分析的第一步。

title: Modeling Field-Level Conservation Tillage Adoption with Aggregate Choice Data
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics

title: Screening the Suitability of Levee Protected Areas for Strategic Floodplain Reconnection Along the LaGrange Segment of the Illinois River, USA
abstract: Levee‐protected floodplains along the 125‐km LaGrange Segment (LGS) of the Illinois River were screened for their abiotic suitability for alternative ecosystem services (ESs), including wetland creation, habitat, floodwater denitrification and flood‐tolerant agriculture. The suitability framework developed for this study builds upon the Land Capability Potential Index and is informed by the current understanding of the linkages between river hydrology, hydraulics, floodplain soils, floodplain vegetation and floodplain nutrient cycling. In addition to screening these floodplain areas for alternative ESs, we demonstrate how this framework can be combined with economic assessments of current floodplain services to inform how strategic floodplain reconnection (i.e. restoration of hydrologic linkages between river and floodplain for the purpose of flood mitigation and provisioning of alternative ESs) could be used to work towards sustainable floodplain management. Results show that ESs increase with upstream distance from the LaGrange Lock and Dam. This is attributed to the operation of the lock and dam generating a water level that would result in the inundation of a substantial portion of floodplain (>70 km2) up to ˜60 km upstream if the levees were to be removed or set back. Comparison of the profits from current floodplain agriculture with the potential profits of flood‐tolerant agriculture suggests that overcoming the economic costs of floodplain reconnection within the LGS will likely require both conversion of reconnected floodplain lands to flood‐tolerant agriculture and payments for ESs. abstract_zh: 我们对伊利诺伊河125公里长的拉格朗日河段（LaGrange Segment, LGS）沿岸受堤防保护的洪泛平原进行了筛选，评估其对替代性生态系统服务（ESs）的非生物适宜性，这些服务包括湿地营造、栖息地、洪水反硝化以及耐淹农业。本研究所开发的适宜性框架以土地容量潜力指数（Land Capability Potential Index）为基础，并结合了当前对河流水文、水力学、洪泛平原土壤、洪泛平原植被与洪泛平原养分循环之间联系的认识。除了筛选这些洪泛平原区域是否适合发展替代性生态系统服务之外，我们还展示了如何将该框架与现有洪泛平原服务的经济评估相结合，以说明战略性洪泛平原再连通（即为防洪减灾和提供替代性生态系统服务而恢复河流与洪泛平原之间的水文联系）如何用于推进可持续的洪泛平原管理。结果表明，生态系统服务随距拉格朗日闸坝上游距离的增加而提高。这归因于闸坝运行所形成的水位，若移除或后退堤防，将淹没上游约60公里范围内相当大一部分（超过70平方公里）的洪泛平原。将当前洪泛平原农业利润与耐淹农业的潜在利润进行比较后发现，要克服拉格朗日河段内洪泛平原再连通的经济成本，可能既需要将再连通的洪泛平原土地转为耐淹农业，也需要进行生态系统服务支付。版权所有 © 2016 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd。

title: Tradeoffs of strategically reconnecting rivers to their floodplains: The case of the Lower Illinois River (USA)
Fish Consumers: Environmental Attitudes and Purchasing Behavior
abstract: The objective of this study was to expand on the limited awareness of the U.S. fish consumer. Measures were tested through a Web-based national survey. The final survey consisted of 40 questions, including environmental awareness, food neophobia, fish consumption, reasons for consuming fish, and demographic variables. Correlations and t tests were used to analyze relationships between eating fish in restaurants and other variables. Hierarchical cluster analysis was used to segment respondents into two groups based on their environmental awareness and neophylic/neophobic attitudes. EcoFish consumers were more likely to be male, eat fish for health and the environment, and eat fish at restaurants significantly more than the Indifferent Fish consumers. Restaurants can use these results to market to eco-friendly, health-conscious fish consumers.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在拓展对美国鱼类消费者有限认知的理解。我们通过一项基于网络的全国性调查对测量指标进行了检验。最终问卷包括40个问题，涵盖环境意识、食物新奇恐惧（food neophobia）、鱼类消费、食用鱼类的原因以及人口统计变量。我们使用相关分析和t检验来分析在餐厅就餐与其他变量之间的关系。我们采用层次聚类分析，根据受访者的环境意识以及对新事物的喜好或恐惧态度，将其划分为两组。与无偏好型（Indifferent）鱼类消费者相比，“生态鱼”（EcoFish）消费者更可能为男性，因健康和环境原因食用鱼类，并且在餐厅用餐时食用鱼类的频率显著更高。餐厅可以利用这些结果，向注重环保、关注健康的鱼类消费者进行营销。

title: Impact of energy prices and cellulosic biomass supply on agriculture, energy, and the environment: An integrated modeling approach
Investigating impacts of alternative crop market scenarios on land use change with an agent-based model
abstract: We developed an agent-based model (ABM) to simulate farmers’ decisions on crop type and fertilizer application in response to commodity and biofuel crop prices. Farm profit maximization constrained by farmers’ profit expectations for land committed to biofuel crop production was used as the decision rule. Empirical parameters characterizing farmers’ profit expectations were derived from an agricultural landowners and operators survey and integrated in the ABM. The integration of crop production cost models and the survey information in the ABM is critical to producing simulations that can provide realistic insights into agricultural land use planning and policy making. Model simulations were run with historical market prices and alternative market scenarios for corn price, soybean to corn price ratio, switchgrass price, and switchgrass to corn stover ratio. The results of the comparison between simulated cropland percentage and crop rotations with satellite-based land cover data suggest that farmers may be underestimating the effects that continuous corn production has on yields. The simulation results for alternative market scenarios based on a survey of agricultural land owners and operators in the Clear Creek Watershed in eastern Iowa show that farmers see cellulosic biofuel feedstock production in the form of perennial grasses or corn stover as a more risky enterprise than their current crop production systems, likely because of market and production risks and lock in effects. As a result farmers do not follow a simple farm-profit maximization rule.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个基于主体的模型（agent-based model, ABM），用以模拟农民在商品作物和生物燃料作物价格变化下，关于作物种类和施肥量的决策。决策规则采用农业利润最大化，并受农民对用于生物燃料作物生产的土地的利润预期约束。刻画农民利润预期的经验参数来自对农业土地所有者和经营者的调查，并被纳入该模型。将作物生产成本模型与调查信息整合进该ABM，对于生成能够为农业土地利用规划和政策制定提供切实可靠见解的模拟结果至关重要。我们以历史市场价格以及玉米价格、大豆与玉米价格比、柳枝稷价格以及柳枝稷与玉米秸秆比等替代市场情景运行了模型。将模拟得到的耕地比例和轮作模式与基于卫星的土地覆被数据进行比较后发现，农民可能低估了连作玉米对产量的影响。基于对爱荷华州东部克利尔溪流域（Clear Creek Watershed）农业土地所有者和经营者调查的替代市场情景模拟结果表明，农民认为以多年生草本或玉米秸秆形式生产纤维素生物燃料原料，比其当前的作物生产体系风险更大，这可能是由于市场和生产风险以及锁定效应（lock-in effects）所致。因此，农民并不遵循简单的农场利润最大化规则。

title: A Comparison of Value Elicitation Question Formats in Multiple-Good Contingent Valuation
The impact of gender on agricultural conservation knowledge and attitudes in an Iowa watershed
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Female agricultural land ownership and operatorship are on the rise in Iowa and across the nation, but little research exists that explores agricultural conservation outreach to women and gendered differences in conservation knowledge and attitudes. The authors surveyed all agricultural landowners and operators in the Clear Creek Watershed in eastern Iowa about conservation knowledge and attitudes, as well as preferred sources of information about conservation. Clear Creek is a high-visibility watershed for conservation outreach for several reasons, including its long-standing watershed stakeholder council and its connection to the impaired Iowa River. Analysis of the survey results demonstrated that female respondents had significantly lower levels of knowledge about best management practices and significantly more positive attitudes towards conservation and collaboration than men. Meanwhile, women looked to the same sources for conservation information as male respondents, including neighbors, friends, and conservation agencies like the Natural Resources Conservation Service, Cooperative Extension, and the Farm Service Agency. These gendered results have significant consequences for the future of agricultural conservation practice and policy and for the subsequent health of the nation's soils and waterways. While lacking in knowledge about specific conservation practices, female respondents valued conservation practices, looked to government agencies for information about conservation, and expressed interest in collaborating with government entities for conservation on their land. Agricultural conservation practitioners can use these findings to tailor outreach efforts that will more effectively reach the nation's female landowners and operators.
abstract_zh: 在爱荷华州以及全国范围内，女性拥有和经营农业用地的比例正在上升，但很少有研究探讨面向女性的农业保护推广，以及保护知识与态度上的性别差异。作者对爱荷华州东部克利尔溪流域的全部农业土地所有者和经营者进行了调查，内容涉及保护知识与态度，以及他们偏好的保护信息来源。克利尔溪是保护推广的高关注度流域，原因包括其长期存在的流域利益相关方理事会，以及其与受损的爱荷华河（Iowa River）之间的关联。调查结果分析表明，女性受访者在最佳管理实践（best management practices）方面的知识水平显著较低，而对保护与合作的态度则显著更为积极。与此同时，女性与男性受访者在保护信息来源上相同，包括邻居、朋友，以及自然资源保护局（NRCS）、合作推广机构（Cooperative Extension）和农场服务局（FSA）等保护机构。这些性别差异结果对农业保护实践和政策的未来，以及全国土壤和水体的长期健康具有重要影响。尽管女性受访者在具体保护做法方面知识欠缺，但她们重视保护性做法，依赖政府机构获取保护信息，并表示有兴趣与政府部门合作，在其土地上开展保护工作。农业保护从业者可利用这些发现，调整推广工作，从而更有效地覆盖全国的女性土地所有者和经营者。

title: How to sell ecosystem services: a guide for designing new markets
venue: Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment
abstract: Payments for ecosystem services (PES) can improve environmental quality by aligning the incentives of individual landowners with societal interests in providing valuable ecosystem services such as carbon storage, water quality, flood control, and wildlife habitat. However, for this potential to be realized, many institutional details and technical challenges must be addressed. In this review, we discuss six critical issues for creating effective PES markets: using the appropriate type of market institution, defining suitable spatial and temporal scales for the market, promoting additionality (avoiding payments for services that would have been provided even in the absence of payments) so that payments result in increased services, offering incentives for projects that generate multiple ecosystem services, considering practice‐based versus performance‐based payments, and eliminating opportunities for strategic behavior aimed at “gaming the system”. We illustrate these issues with an example of how PES could be applied to floodplain restoration.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务支付（Payments for ecosystem services, PES）可以通过使单个土地所有者的激励与社会对碳储存、水质、防洪和野生动物栖息地等重要生态系统服务的需求相一致，从而改善环境质量。然而，要实现这一潜力，必须解决众多制度细节和技术挑战。在本综述中，我们讨论了建立有效PES市场的六个关键问题：采用适当类型的市场制度；为市场确定合适的空间和时间尺度；促进额外性（即避免为本就会在无支付情况下提供的服务付费），从而使支付带来服务的增加；为产生多种生态系统服务的项目提供激励；权衡基于实践的支付与基于绩效的支付；以及消除旨在“钻制度空子”的策略性行为机会。我们以PES应用于洪泛平原恢复的案例来说明这些问题。

title: Human consumption as an invasive species management strategy. A preliminary assessment of the marketing potential of invasive Asian carp in the US
Integration of agricultural and energy system models for biofuel assessment
Iowa farmers' responses to transformative scenarios for Corn Belt agriculture
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: T ransformative approaches to agricultural research, policy, and practice could result in future agricultural landscapes that are very different from the present. The National Research Council (2010) report Toward Sustainable Agricultural Systems in the 21st Century recommends that incremental approaches to improving sustainability, which work within existing agricultural systems, be augmented by transformative approaches, which introduce and assess the possibilities for more dramatic change. Biofuels, environmental effects of agriculture, and farmer adoption of sustainable practices should be among the key considerations in transformative approaches to 21st century agriculture in the Corn Belt. BIOFUELS Biofuels have emerged as the leading non-nuclear alternative to fossil fuels (SEG 2007), and transformative approaches can provide information about the merits of different biofuels—corn ethanol compared with other feedstocks, including perennial grasses for cellulosic ethanol (Robertson et al. 2008; Jordan et al. 2007). Current agricultural and energy policy have provoked dramatic increases in corn and soybean production for biofuels (Sorenson and Daukas 2010; Lubowski et al. 2008). With effective future commercial scale technologies, perennial grass feedstock for cellulosic ethanol may outperform corn ethanol in terms of net energy production, terrestrial carbon storage, and other ecosystem services (Simpson et al. 2008; Fargione et al. 2008).
abstract_zh: 农业研究、政策和实践中的转型性方法，可能会形成与当前截然不同的未来农业景观。美国国家研究理事会（National Research Council）2010年的报告《迈向21世纪的可持续农业系统》（Toward Sustainable Agricultural Systems in the 21st Century）建议，在现有农业系统内渐进改善可持续性的做法，应辅以引入并评估更大幅度变革可能性的转型性方法。生物燃料、农业的环境影响以及农民对可持续做法的采纳，应当成为21世纪玉米带农业转型性方法的重要考量因素。生物燃料：生物燃料已成为化石燃料的主要非核替代品（SEG 2007），而转型性方法可以提供有关不同生物燃料优劣的信息，包括玉米乙醇与其他原料（如用于纤维素乙醇的多年生草本）的比较（Robertson et al. 2008; Jordan et al. 2007）。当前的农业和能源政策已推动玉米和大豆用于生物燃料的产量大幅增长（Sorenson and Daukas 2010; Lubowski et al. 2008）。在具备有效的商业化规模技术之后，用于纤维素乙醇的多年生草本原料在净能量产出、陆地碳储存及其他生态系统服务方面，可能会优于玉米乙醇（Simpson et al. 2008; Fargione et al. 2008）。

title: Land use change in a biofuels hotspot: The case of Iowa, USA
Potential water quality changes due to corn expansion in the Upper Mississippi River Basin
abstract: While biofuels may yield renewable fuel benefits, there could be downsides in terms of water quality and other environmental stressors, particularly if corn is relied upon exclusively as the feedstock. The consequences of increased corn production will depend importantly on where (and how) the additional corn is grown, which, in turn, depends on the characteristics of land and its associated profitability. Previous work has relied on rules of thumb for allocating land to increased acreage based on historical land use or other heuristics. Here, we advance our understanding of these phenomena by describing a modeling system that links an economics-driven land use model with a watershed-based water quality model for the Upper Mississippi River Basin (UMRB). This modeling system is used to assess the water quality changes due to increased corn acreage, which is associated with higher relative corn prices. We focus on six scenarios based on six realistic pairs of corn and soybean prices which correspond to a scale of decreasing soybean to corn price ratio. These price-driven land use changes provide estimates of the water quality effects that current biofuel policies may have in the UMRB. Our analysis can help evaluate the costs and environmental consequences associated with implementation strategies for the biofuel mandates of the new energy bill. The amounts of total N and P delivered to the outlet of the UMRB (located at Grafton, Illinois, USA) rise as corn production becomes more intensive in the region. Our results indicate that a 14.4% in corn acreage in the watershed due to corn intensification in the most economically profitable locations would result in a 5.4% increase in total nitrogen loads and in a 4.1% increase in total phosphorus loads at Grafton. Our most aggressive scenario, driven by high but not out of reach crop prices, results in about a 57% increase in corn acreage with a corresponding 18.5% increase in N and 12% increase in P. These are somewhat conservative increases in nutrients, compared to those of previous studies, likely due to our focus on cultivated cropland which is already heavily fertilized.
abstract_zh: 尽管生物燃料可能带来可再生燃料效益，但其在水质及其他环境压力方面也可能存在负面影响，特别是当玉米被完全依赖作为原料时。玉米增产的后果在很大程度上取决于额外的玉米种植在何处（以及如何种植），而这又取决于土地的特征及其相关盈利能力。以往的研究依赖经验法则，根据历史土地利用或其他启发式方法来分配增加的种植面积。在此，我们通过描述一种建模系统，将基于经济驱动的土地利用模型与密西西比河上游流域（Upper Mississippi River Basin, UMRB）的流域水质模型相连接，从而推进了对这些现象的理解。该建模系统用于评估因玉米种植面积增加而带来的水质变化，而玉米种植面积的增加与玉米相对价格较高相关联。我们聚焦于六种情景，它们基于六组现实可行的玉米与大豆价格组合，对应于大豆与玉米价格比逐渐降低的梯度。这些由价格驱动的土地利用变化，为当前生物燃料政策可能对UMRB水质产生的影响提供了估计。我们的分析有助于评估新能源法案中生物燃料掺混任务的实施策略所涉及的成本和环境后果。输送至UMRB出口（位于伊利诺伊州格拉夫顿，Grafton, Illinois, USA）的总氮和总磷量，随着该地区玉米生产集约化程度的提高而上升。我们的结果表明，流域内因在经济上最有利可图的地点实施玉米集约化，导致玉米种植面积增加14.4%，将使格拉夫顿的总氮负荷增加5.4%，总磷负荷增加4.1%。我们最激进的情景是在高但并非不可企及的作物价格驱动下，玉米种植面积增加约57%，相应的氮增加18.5%、磷增加12%。与以往研究相比，这些养分增幅相对保守，可能是因为我们的研究聚焦于本已大量施肥的耕地。

title: Corn-based ethanol production and environmental quality: A case of Iowa and the Conservation Reserve Program
Least-cost control of agricultural nutrient contributions to the Gulf of Mexico hypoxic zone
abstract: In 2008, the hypoxic zone in the Gulf of Mexico, measuring 20 720 km2, was one of the two largest reported since measurement of the zone began in 1985. The extent of the hypoxic zone is related to nitrogen and phosphorous loadings originating on agricultural fields in the upper Midwest. This study combines the tools of evolutionary computation with a water quality model and cost data to develop a trade-off frontier for the Upper Mississippi River Basin specifying the least cost of achieving nutrient reductions and the location of the agricultural conservation practices needed. The frontier allows policymakers and stakeholders to explicitly see the trade-offs between cost and nutrient reductions. For example, the cost of reducing annual nitrate-N loadings by 30% is estimated to be US$1.4 billion/year, with a concomitant 36% reduction in P and the cost of reducing annual P loadings by 30% is estimated to be US$370 million/year, with a concomitant 9% reduction in nitrate-N.
abstract_zh: 2008年，墨西哥湾缺氧区的面积为20 720 km2，是自1985年开始测量以来所记录的两个最大面积之一。缺氧区的范围与美国中西部上游农田产生的氮和磷负荷有关。本研究将进化计算工具与水质模型及成本数据相结合，为上密西西比河流域构建了一条权衡前沿，用以说明实现养分减排的最低成本以及所需农业保护措施的位置。该前沿使决策者和利益相关者能够清楚地看到成本与养分减排之间的权衡。例如，将每年硝酸盐氮负荷减少30%的成本估计为每年14亿美元，同时磷减少36%；而将每年磷负荷减少30%的成本估计为每年3.7亿美元，同时硝酸盐氮减少9%。

title: Sustainable floodplains through large-scale reconnection to rivers
High crop prices and conservation - Raising the stakes
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Agricultural conservation policy does not happen in a vacuum but, rather, is linked to a myriad of other policies affecting individual farms, national and international trade, and energy production and distribution. While the primary purpose of commodity subsidies is to supplement farmer income, they have also had a strong influence on cropland expansion and agricultural intensification. One result of this expansion and intensification has been burgeoning crop productivity. Another has been a decline in the provision of ecosystem services, the benefits that people obtain from ecosystems. The services people obtain from agroecosystems include soil stabilization and enhancement, water filtration and flood control, carbon sequestration, wildlife habitat, and recreation opportunities (e.g., hunting and wildlife viewing). This tension between farmer income support and the provision of ecosystem services is inherent to the current configuration of US agricultural conservation policies such as the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP). Developed during a time of crop surpluses, CRP was originally a set-aside mechanism to reduce both soil erosion and the overall amount of crops produced. Today, the program has a stronger focus on environmental impacts.
abstract_zh: 农业保护政策并非孤立存在，而是与影响单个农场、国内外贸易以及能源生产与分配的诸多其他政策相互关联。虽然商品补贴的主要目的是补充农民收入，但它们也对耕地扩张和农业集约化产生了强烈影响。这种扩张与集约化的一个结果是作物生产力的迅速提高。另一个结果则是生态系统服务的下降，即人们从生态系统中获得的利益。人们从农业生态系统中获得的服务包括土壤稳定与改良、水体过滤与防洪、碳封存、野生动物栖息地以及休闲机会（例如狩猎和观赏野生动物）。农民收入支持与生态系统服务供给之间的这种张力，内在于美国当前的农业保护政策架构之中，例如保护储备计划（Conservation Reserve Program, CRP）。该计划制定于农产品过剩的时期，最初是一种休耕机制，旨在减少土壤侵蚀以及作物总产量。如今，该计划更加注重环境影响。

title: The cost of cleaner water: Assessing agricultural pollution reduction at the watershed scale
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Nonpoint source pollution in intensively managed agricultural landscapes is of great concern to the general population, farmers and policymakers, as it impacts local water quality and can have large downstream effects, as in the case of hypoxia in the Gulf of Mexico. In this study, we outline a methodology to simultaneously assess economic costs and water quality benefits associated with the hypothetical placement of a broad set of conservation practices. The study, performed for the Iowa Department of Natural Resources, assesses thirteen major subbasins in Iowa by interfacing economic models with the Soil and Water Assessment Tool model. The conservation practices analyzed include land set-aside, terraces, grassed waterways, contouring, conservation tillage, and a simple nutrient reduction strategy. Annual costs range from $300 to $597 million. Predicted sediment, total phosphorus (P), and nitrate decreases range from six to 65 percent, 28 to 59 percent, and six to 20 percent, respectively, relative to the baseline.
abstract_zh: 在集约化管理的农业景观中，面源污染引起了普通民众、农民和政策制定者的广泛关注，因为它影响当地水质，并可能产生大范围的下游影响，墨西哥湾缺氧即是一例。在本研究中，我们概述了一种方法，用以同时评估与假设性地布设一系列广泛保护措施相关的经济成本和水质效益。该研究由爱荷华州自然资源部委托进行，通过将经济模型与土壤和水评估工具模型相结合，对爱荷华州13个主要子流域进行了评估。所分析的保护措施包括休耕、梯田、草水道、等高耕作、保护性耕作以及一项简单的养分减排策略。年成本范围为3亿至5.97亿美元。相对于基准情景，预测的泥沙、总磷和硝酸盐分别减少6%至65%、28%至59%和6%至20%。
